mapper.select: select vb.id,ifnull(sum(vs.likes),0) total_likes from village_base vb left join village_scenic vs on vb.id = vs.village_id group by vb.id order by total_likes desc
select vb.id,ifnull(sum(vs.collections),0) total_collections from village_base vb left join village_scenic vs on vb.id=vs.village_id group by vb.id order by total_collections desc
